# Glass Robo

Glass Robo is a glassy interface offering six color schemes and custom fonts. The recorded description lists file and folder icons, metadata icons, 20 callout styles, eight header styles, interface elements that auto-hide, and a set of custom checkboxes for expressive task states.

![Glass Robo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lorens-osman-dev/Glass-Robo/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue

    name:   "Glass Robo"
    author: "lorens-osman-dev"
    repo:   "lorens-osman-dev/Glass-Robo"
    slug:   "glass-robo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/glass-robo"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a glassy, modern interface with six color schemes and custom fonts. Show neat file/folder and metadata icons, 20 callout styles, eight header styles, auto-hide UI elements and a set of custom checkboxes for expressive task states."
}
```
